geometry.locator: arXiv:2407.11912, 'positioned at (20.7 +/- 0.1) m from the reactor core center'
geometry.note: CONUS+'s own paper (arXiv:2407.11912) states the detector sits 20.7 m from the reactor core center, 12.45 m horizontal distance from the reactor central axis, inside room ZA28R027 of the KKL containment building -- i.e. inside the reactor building itself, not a separate structure. No fetched source gives the azimuth of that horizontal offset, so this point is the candidate reactor-building's own centroid (geometry:leibstadt-core), used directly as the detector's position; accuracy_m is widened to 35 m to cover both the unresolved ~12-21 m offset and the building's own 30 m identification accuracy (see geometry:leibstadt-core note).

name: CONUS+ detector position (inside the Leibstadt reactor building)

summary.plain: The approximate position of the CONUS+ coherent-neutrino-scattering detector, which sits inside the Leibstadt reactor building about 20.7 m from the reactor core, since late 2023.
